meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将复杂工作分解为循证步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望把模糊目标拆解成可执行、有依据的步骤
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex work into evidence-based steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to decompose vague goals into actionable, evidence-backed steps

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你的目标拆成一连串细小的步骤,按顺序执行,每一步都检查真实结果并记录证据;代码修改和测试会交给 Codex 子代理,最终逐步核对后才算完成。
howto.when: 当你提到 “ulw-loop” 或 “ulw”,或请求执行需要证据和检查点的长期目标时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 把这个目标拆成步骤,逐步执行并验证。
say.note: Claude 会先读取流程文档并注册目标。

say.text: 启动 ulw,按证据驱动的方式完成这个任务。
say.note: Claude 会开始分解并记录证据。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 模式进行手动 QA 和检查点交付。
say.note: Claude 会遵循手动 QA 渠道规则。

howto.what_en: Claude breaks your goal into tiny steps, executes them in order, checks real results, records evidence for each. Code edits/tests go to Codex subagents; done only after step-by-step verification.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say “ulw-loop” or “ulw”, or ask for long-running goal execution with evidence and checkpoints.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to break this goal into steps, execute and verify.
say_en.note: Claude reads the workflow and registers the goal first.

say_en.text: Start ulw in evidence-driven mode for this task.
say_en.note: Claude begins decomposing and recording evidence.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop for manual QA and checkpointed delivery.
say_en.note: Claude follows the manual-QA channel rules.
